Overview

Oujda is a city in Oriental with a population of 494,000. A border city near Algeria with a rich history, known for its French-colonial architecture and vibrant cultural scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 275 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
